title: A Comprehensive Analysis of Large Language Model Outputs: Similarity, Diversity, and Bias

bias_targets.methodology: Training word embeddings (Word2Vec) on model-generated text and calculating DirectBias scores by measuring the cosine similarity between a defined gender subspace (e.g., he-she, man-woman) and neutral occupation words.
